_source: Chinese Muslim Association ROC 1446AH (2025) revised Ramadan timetable, cmainroc.org.tw hot_511195.html
_publisher_tier: authority (national Muslim association of Taiwan; both state review by the imams' council)
_sampling: SAMPLED, not full transcription: anchor dates only, chosen to expose year-over-year drift. The full 2026 table is in taiwan-taipei_cma-ramadan-1447.json
_columns: fajr, sunrise, dhuhr, asr, magrib, isha; suhoor = fasting cut-off printed 20 min before fajr
_of_note: Every city offset moved between the three editions except Hsinchu and Penghu's suhoor. Hualien iftar went +1 (2024) to -1 (2025) to +1 (2026). Hengchun went +3/+6, +4/+3, +2/+6. The 2025 table's 2025-03-30 maghrib (18:14) undercuts 2025-03-29 (18:16) by two minutes; the 2024 table prints Taitung suhoor as 'minus 0 minutes'. Both carried as printed.
